pages.name: Amazon Attack
pages.notes: Plan 2 had a later ...Ne4 from a knight on c6, which cannot reach e4; plan 3 called the c1-bishop passive, though its diagonal is open. Rewrote plans 2-3 around ...c5, ...Bf5 and ...Nc6-b4 hitting the queen. British spelling.

pages.name: Blackmar-Diemer Gambit Accepted: Bogoljubow Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a rook lift Rf3-h3 with the knight on f3. Rewrote it around Bc4, O-O, Qe1-h4 and Bh6. British spelling.

pages.name: Blackmar-Diemer Gambit Accepted: Pietrowsky Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a rook lift Rf3-h3 with the knight on f3. Rewrote it around Bc4/Bb5, Bg5, O-O and Qe1-h4. British spelling.

pages.name: Blackmar-Diemer Gambit Accepted: Ryder Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave Ng5, which the g1-knight cannot reach; plan 2 was vague about further sacrifices. Rewrote both around Be3, Bd3, O-O-O and the ...Qxd4 Be3 point (first plan 1 rewrite rejected for calling the f-file open with Black's f7-pawn on it; corrected and accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Blackmar-Diemer Gambit Accepted: Teichmann Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 broke the pin with h3 and g4, when Black simply takes on f3. Rewrote it around h3 Bxf3 Qxf3, the bishop pair and O-O-O (first rewrite rejected for calling the f-file open; corrected and accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Blackmar-Diemer Gambit Declined: Elbert Countergambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 used an open f-file with White's pawn on f3; plan 2 had ...Nxe4, a capture of Black's own pawn. Rewrote both around dxe5 Qxd1+ and ...Nfd7 or ...Ng4. British spelling.

pages.name: Blackmar-Diemer Gambit Declined: Langeheinicke Defense
pages.notes: Overview said 4...e3 blocks the d-pawn; plan 1 gave Be2/d3 and plan 2 wrote ...0-0; plan 3 fianchettoed the bishop to get round an e3-pawn White has just taken. Rewrote the overview (first rewrite rejected for 'open f-file'; corrected and accepted) and all four plans. British spelling.

pages.name: Blackmar-Diemer Gambit Declined: Vienna Defense
pages.notes: Plan 2 gave g4 as a Black move. Rewrote it. British spelling.

pages.name: Blackmar-Diemer Gambit: Blackmar Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 named sacrifices on e6 or f7 as bare squares; plan 3 left out 3...e5, Black's main way to strike back. Rewrote plans 1 and 3.

pages.name: Blackmar-Diemer Gambit: Netherlands Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 gave Ng5, which the g1-knight cannot reach. Rewrote it. British spelling.
